{{Navbar-Global Gas Infrastructure Tracker}}
'''Eagle Ford Chisholm Pipeline''' is an operating natural gas pipeline in the United States.<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.eia.gov/naturalgas/pipelines/EIA-NaturalGasPipelineProjectsAug2026.xlsx|title=eia.gov|website=eia.gov|access-date=2026-11-04}}</ref>

==Location==
The pipeline runs from DeWitt County, Texas to LaGrange processing plant, Fayette County, Texas.<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.ogj.com/pipelines-transportation/pipelines/article/17284323/etp-announces-two-eagle-ford-gas-pipelines|title=ogj.com|website=ogj.com|access-date=2026-11-04}}</ref>

==Project Details==
*'''Owner: '''Energy Transfer LP<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.eia.gov/naturalgas/pipelines/EIA-NaturalGasPipelineProjectsAug2026.xlsx|title=eia.gov|website=eia.gov|access-date=2026-11-04}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.ogj.com/pipelines-transportation/pipelines/article/17284323/etp-announces-two-eagle-ford-gas-pipelines|title=ogj.com|website=ogj.com|access-date=2026-11-04}}</ref>
*'''Capacity: '''300 MMcf/d<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.eia.gov/naturalgas/pipelines/EIA-NaturalGasPipelineProjectsAug2026.xlsx|title=eia.gov|website=eia.gov|access-date=2026-11-04}}</ref>
*'''Length: '''83 mi<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.eia.gov/naturalgas/pipelines/EIA-NaturalGasPipelineProjectsAug2026.xlsx|title=eia.gov|website=eia.gov|access-date=2026-11-04}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.ogj.com/pipelines-transportation/pipelines/article/17284323/etp-announces-two-eagle-ford-gas-pipelines|title=ogj.com|website=ogj.com|access-date=2026-11-04}}</ref>
*'''Diameter: '''20 in<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.eia.gov/naturalgas/pipelines/EIA-NaturalGasPipelineProjectsAug2026.xlsx|title=eia.gov|website=eia.gov|access-date=2026-11-04}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.ogj.com/pipelines-transportation/pipelines/article/17284323/etp-announces-two-eagle-ford-gas-pipelines|title=ogj.com|website=ogj.com|access-date=2026-11-04}}</ref>
*'''Status: '''Operating<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.eia.gov/naturalgas/pipelines/EIA-NaturalGasPipelineProjectsAug2026.xlsx|title=eia.gov|website=eia.gov|access-date=2026-11-04}}</ref>
*'''Proposal year: '''2010
*'''Start year: '''2011<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.eia.gov/naturalgas/pipelines/EIA-NaturalGasPipelineProjectsAug2026.xlsx|title=eia.gov|website=eia.gov|access-date=2026-11-04}}</ref>
